units.source_text: 初七夜的月亮清影幽微，照见池面暮烟笼罩，一片朦胧。

en.t: On the seventh night, the moon cast a faint, clear light, revealing the pond surface veiled in evening mist and wrapped in haze.

units.source_text: 枝头绿叶尚未成荫，正是风景岑寂之候。

en.t: The green leaves on the branches had not yet grown dense enough to give shade, and the scene was just at its loneliest season.

units.source_text: 只有开在树干不高而枝丫千姿百态的松树上的藤花异常艳丽。

en.t: Only the wisteria blooming on the low-trunked pines, whose branches took on countless shapes, was exceptionally brilliant.

units.source_text: 那位弁少将红梅便用美妙的嗓子唱起催马乐《苇垣》来。

en.t: That Ben no Shosho, Kobai, then began to sing the saibara song Ashigaki in a beautiful voice.

units.source_text: 内大臣听了非常高兴，叫道：“这曲歌真有意思啊！”

en.t: The Minister of the Interior was delighted to hear it and exclaimed, This song is truly charming.

units.source_text: 便跟着他助唱：“此家由来久……”

en.t: Then he joined in after him, lending his voice to the line, This house has long and ancient origins.
His singing voice too was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 在这兴高采烈、放任不拘的宴会上，从前的旧恨尽行消失了。

en.t: At this cheerful and unrestrained banquet, all the old resentments from the past vanished completely.
